content.title: How to Apply for 2026 Masters Golf Tournament Tickets
content.text: Applying for Masters Tickets While it is too late to apply for the 2025 Masters Golf Tournament, it is a good time to learn how you can apply for the 2026 Masters Golf Tournament. The first step is to visit the official Masters website. If you are a new applicant, you should create an account to prepare for the 2026 application process. The applications open June 1st and close on June 20th, 2025. If you are selected in the drawings, payments open in Late July. Be sure to watch your email once you sign up to stay up to date on any additional information that may be released. These updates could be helpful to you in your endeavor to obtain tickets. Find a place to stay If you already have tickets to the 2025 Masters Golf Tournament or are looking ahead to 2026, Masters Housing Bureau is the best place to search for a place to stay. We offer the most trusted and experienced service for the Masters Golf Tournament accommodations and housing. Masters Housing Bureau is the largest and most trusted housing rental agency in Augusta for the Masters and has rented to golfers, corporations, representatives, staff and patrons for 50 years. We offer many different types of homes that are sure to fit your needs. Time to search! Whether you are only staying for the practice rounds or you're able to experience the full Masters week, finding the right place to stay is essential to fully enjoying the best week of the year at the Augusta National. Masters Housing Bureau offers the area's most comprehensive selection of quality properties in the Augusta area, so it is easy to find the perfect place. As the Augusta Region’s first, foremost, and only rental agency associated and sanctioned with the Augusta National Golf Club, you can trust Masters Housing Bureau to provide you with experienced service and high-quality accommodations that you can trust. If you have any questions or concerns, do not hesitate to contact us. We've dealt with every situation imaginable, and we can take care of your housing needs.
